products.title: ASK-1000 Active Noise Cancelling Bluetooth Headset
products.title_zh: ASK-1000 主动降噪蓝牙耳机
products.sub_title_zh: 混合式主动降噪，多点连接，40 小时续航
products.descr:
This active noise cancelling headset delivers hybrid ANC that reduces ambient noise up to 35dB. The 40-hour playtime covers multi-day travel. It supports multipoint pairing across two devices.

  • Hybrid ANC up to 35dB
  • Bluetooth 5.3, low latency
  • 40h battery, USB-C fast charge
The flagship ANC series for business and travel users.
products.descr_zh:
这款主动降噪耳机采用 混合式 ANC 架构，最高可降低 35dB 环境噪声。40 小时续航可满足多日出差使用，并支持两台设备之间的多点连接。

  • 混合式 ANC，降噪深度达 35dB
  • 蓝牙 5.3，低延迟
  • 40 小时续航，USB-C 快充
面向商务与出行用户的旗舰降噪系列。
products.params:
SpecValue
Driver40mm dynamic

Note: Charging time 4h 2h with fast charge adapter.

products.title: ASK-250 Industrial Two-Way Radio Headset
products.sub_title: Noise immune, PTT control, IP54 rated
products.sub_title_zh: 抗噪麦克风，PTT 一键对讲，IP54 防护
products.descr:
Engineered for noisy industrial environments, the ASK-250 uses a noise immune microphone and delivers crystal clear two-way communication.

  1. PTT one-touch transmit
  2. IP54 dust and splash resistant
  3. Wearable boom mic
PTT_MODES = ["push", "voice"]
radio.connect(device="ASK-250")
products.descr_zh:
ASK-250 专为高噪声工业环境打造，采用抗噪麦克风，双向对讲清晰稳定。

  1. PTT 一键发射
  2. IP54 防尘防溅
  3. 可佩戴式麦克风杆
PTT_MODES = ["push", "voice"]
radio.connect(device="ASK-250")

防护等级IP54
频段VHF/UHF

products.title: ASK-300 E-Sports Wireless Headset
products.sub_title_zh: 2.4GHz 低延迟，虚拟环绕声，RGB 灯效
products.descr:
The ASK-300 is built for competitive gaming with 2.4GHz low-latency connection and virtual surround sound.

  • 17ms ultra-low latency
  • 42mm drivers
  • Detachable noise-cancelling mic
products.descr_zh:
ASK-300 为竞技游戏而生，采用 2.4GHz 低延迟连接与虚拟环绕声。

  • 17ms 超低延迟
  • 42mm 驱动单元
  • 可拆卸降噪麦克风
